verified_behaviors: Without a secondary index the same equality query plans as a full table scan (type=ALL) over 20000 rows
Adding idx_email turns the plan into type=ref with a single-digit row estimate
A composite covering index produces Extra=Using index, so the query avoids table lookups
A prefix LIKE scan uses type=range
REPEATABLE READ keeps the transaction snapshot even after another session commits
READ COMMITTED observes the latest committed value on every statement
SERIALIZABLE reads take shared locks so a concurrent writer waits and times out with error 1205
Opposite update order makes InnoDB roll back one victim with deadlock error 1213 while the other commits
limitations: Single instance, no replication or crash recovery drill
Index conclusions come from EXPLAIN/ANALYZE rather than InnoDB page-level inspection
supplemented_by: mysql-extra.json（2026-10-31，EXPLAIN ANALYZE 耗时对比 + innodb_deadlock_detect=OFF 超时路径）
superseded_limitations: No EXPLAIN ANALYZE timing comparison or slow-query tuning
